evidence_items.locator: Header and first record; calculation uses all 500 accuracy records
evidence_items.explanation: Summing within participants and comparing the two assignment groups gives a positive difference with two-sided p = 0.01908. This remains significant while respecting repeated measurements.

inputs: All 100 assignment records from participants.csv, joined by id
LLM group: n = 50, mean total = 22.98, sample SD = 6.523083032194053
Internet-only group: n = 50, mean total = 19.94, sample SD = 6.228342066550229
derived.formula: Sum five accuracy scores per participant. Welch t = (22.98 - 19.94) / sqrt(6.523083032194053^2 / 50 + 6.228342066550229^2 / 50) = 2.383410643; Welch-Satterthwaite df = 97.791234; two-sided Student-t p = 0.01908457.
derived.rounding: Displayed p rounded to five decimal places; calculations used unrounded participant totals.
